tools.name: getColivingsByCountry
tools.description: Search for coliving spaces in a specific country. Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (e.g., 'pt' for Portugal, 'es' for Spain, 'th' for Thailand).

tools.name: getColivingsByContinent
tools.description: Search for coliving spaces in a specific continent. Valid continents: Europe, Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Oceania.

tools.name: getColivingsByLocation
tools.description: Search for coliving spaces by location name. Searches across city, region, country name, and coliving name. Use this for flexible location searches like 'Bali', 'Lisbon', 'Barcelona'.

tools.name: getColivingsByBudget
tools.description: Search for coliving spaces within a price range. Prices are per night in EUR. Returns colivings with at least one accommodation within the specified budget.

tools.name: getColivingsByAmenities
tools.description: Search for coliving spaces that have specific amenities/categories. Use category names like 'pool', 'gym', 'surf', 'yoga', 'pet friendly', 'coworking', etc. Use getAllCategories tool to see all available categories.

tools.name: getColivingsByLifestyle
tools.description: Search for coliving spaces by lifestyle category group. Groups: 'community' (shared meals, activities, min stay), 'location' (beach, city, mountain), 'coworking' (desks, monitors, call rooms), 'facilities' (pool, gym, kitchen), 'activities' (yoga, surf, hiking), 'food' (breakfast, vegan), 'structure

tools.name: checkAvailability
tools.description: Check if a coliving has available accommodations for a specific date range and number of guests. Returns available room types with pricing.

tools.name: checkAvailabilityBySlug
tools.description: Check if a coliving has available accommodations using its URL slug instead of ID. Returns available room types with pricing.

tools.name: getAvailabilityByMonth
tools.description: Get a monthly availability overview for a coliving. Returns which accommodation types have available units for each week of the specified month.

tools.name: getColivingById
tools.description: Get full details for a specific coliving by its ID or URL slug. Returns comprehensive information including description, location, amenities, pricing, reviews, and accommodation types.

tools.name: getAccommodations
tools.description: Get all accommodation types (rooms, beds) for a specific coliving. Returns pricing, capacity, and unit details.

tools.name: getColivingReviews
tools.description: Get user reviews for a specific coliving. Returns review text, ratings, and reviewer information.

tools.name: getAllCategories
tools.description: Get all available amenity and lifestyle categories that can be used to filter colivings. Categories are grouped into: location, food, coworking, facilities, structure, activities, community.

tools.name: getAllCountries
tools.description: Get a list of all countries that have active colivings on Mapmelon, grouped by continent. Shows the number of colivings in each country.
